Context confirms the speaker as well: the paragraph runs, For, the outsider will say, in fact, as a woman, I have no country. As a woman I want no country. As a woman my country is the whole world. It sits inside her refusal to ask her brother to fight to protect our country, which is what on 'our' country in the locator points at, and Woolf keeps the words in quotation marks as the outsider's speech, so naming the outsider is required and is done.
